newsitem.title: USA: Orbit division Jan-Aug orders up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Orbit division Jan-Aug orders up 40 pct.

text.p: Orbit International Corp said on Wednesday its commercial division had received 40 percent more orders for its power units and supplies between January and August than it did in the same period last year.
A company official said manufacturers had been ordering Orbit's distortion-free commercial power units and low-noise uninterruptable power supplies for their machines and testing equipment.
The official gave no reason for the rise in demand other than that "we have been cultivating our client base."
Orbit's commercial division generates up to a third of the revenues earned by its electronics division, which makes up most of the company's continuing operations, he said.
The official also said its military division had won several contracts to design and manufacture power processor units and power conversion devices for two contractors.
"It's for the government, in the end," he said.
Orbit, based in Hauppauge, makes customized electronic components and subsystems for military and non-military government applications.
